info.name: qxl.datagrid
info.summary: Virtual, scrolling, spreadsheet-like and tree-like DataGrid widget
info.description: DataGrid provides a virtual, scrolling, spreadsheet-like and tree-like control with asynchronous on-demand data sources supporting millions of rows, rich columns and full theme support (Tangible, Indigo, Simple). Demo: https://qooxdoo.org/qxl.datagrid/
